title: Selling Relève
sub: How owners decide, why they hesitate, and how to sell Relève honestly: from the first message on LinkedIn to a signed client on Starter, with the move to Essential already planned. Every lesson gives you the words and the reason they work.
time: Two and a half to three hours
parts: How owners decide, and how trust is built
Prospecting, outreach, and booking the call
Discovery, the live audit, Relève, the close
Objections, follow-up, the step-up, your numbers
